text:
HUESCA, on ancient and considerable towns of
Spain, in the kingdom of Granada, fieldsed on a plain in W. Long.
1..45, N. Lat. 32.

parsed.faithful: HUESCA, an ancient and confiderable town of Spain, in the kingdom of Arragon, with a bifhop's fee and an univerfity. It is feated on the Iffuela, in a foil producing excellent wine, in W. Long. o. 13. N. Lat. 40. 2.
parsed.modern: HUESCA, an ancient and considerable town of Spain, in the kingdom of Aragon, with a bishop's fee and a university. It is seated on the Iffuela, in a soil producing excellent wine, in W. Long. 0. 13. N. Lat. 40. 2.
